report.translator_summary: Completed translation of op09_03 (80 rows), featuring the dramatic atmospheric reentry confrontation with Chang Wufei in Gundam Nataku (Altron). Covers Wufei's intense philosophical challenge to the Gundam team regarding whether peace bought with sacrifice is truly just, stating he will 'become evil' to test their convictions, followed by Heero Yuy's celebrated retort from Endless Waltz ('How many more must we kill? Zero tells me nothing...'), Stalker's iconic Gundam Fight battle-cry easter egg, developer cues, and concluding with Captain Sinapus's debriefing on Dorchenov's coup and Giganos's transition to all-out hardliner aggression.

uncertainties.note: Preserved Heero Yuy's iconic canonical Endless Waltz soliloquy ('Wufei, tell me... How many more must we kill? Zero tells me nothing...').
Iconic G Gundam tournament catchphrase 'ガンダムファイト！！ レディーーーー、ゴォーーーー！！' rendered in canonical English as 'Gundam Fight!! Ready, gooooo!!'.
Title '総裁' for Dorchenov translated as 'presidency' / supreme leader matching Dragonar lore.
